title: A Prayer for Owen Meany
author: John Irving
summary: A man looks back on growing up in a New Hampshire town with his best friend Owen, a tiny boy with a strange voice who believes he is an instrument of God. Their friendship is bound up with a freak accident.
readIf: you like big, comic and spiritual novels about friendship, faith and fate.
skipIf: you want a light read; it is long, digressive and has a lot to say about Vietnam and politics.

pairings.reason: The author's earlier family saga, equally eccentric but more comic and wild.
Another story about an unusual young friendship framed by fate and loss.
Another narrator reflecting on childhood in a small town and the one person who shaped his sense of right and wrong.
